final_message:
I found and fixed the injected defect with a one-instruction change, and all conformance suites pass again.

**Root cause:** in `implementations/arm64-asm-engine/src/strfuncs.S:398`, inside `like_match` at the `.Llm_tail` label. Once the whole string has been used up, the matcher checks whether the whole pattern has been used up too (`cmp x5, x3`, pattern index against pattern length). That branch had been changed from `b.hs` (index ≥ length) to `b.hi` (index > length). The index never goes past the length, so a fully matched pattern was never accepted. Instead the code read one byte past the end of the pattern, which isn't `%`, and returned false. As a result every `LIKE` was false and every `NOT LIKE` was true. That explains all five failing cases, including the `LIKE '%e%'` filter in `stats_layout_planning.pqt:100`.

**Fix:** changed `b.hi .Llm_true` back to `b.hs .Llm_true`. That one instruction is the only code change; I also added a short entry about the fix to `NOTES.md`.

**Test results:**
- Default run: `TOTAL: 569/569 pass` (phase 1: 225/225, phase 2: 186/186, phase 3: 143/143, phase 5: 15/15), caps=27, so the capability set is unchanged
- `--modes`: `TOTAL: 3324/3324 pass`
- `--transport http`: `TOTAL: 569/569 pass`
- `make build` and `make test` both succeed with no failures in any unit, CLI, HTTP, mode or storage test.

**Commits:** `4880c50` has the fix and `a2d67f8` has the NOTES.md entry. The working tree is clean.

**Known limitations and design decisions:** none are new, since nothing else changed. The LIKE matcher is still the existing iterative one, which falls back to the most recent `%` on a mismatch, so its worst case is O(len(string) × len(pattern)).
